Messages.Body:
In article <3fe60t$6...@columba.udac.uu.se>, b92...@shedir.tdb.uu.se (Robert
Steneholm) wrote:

> I understand everything about this card, that it is politcal etc, except
> when it is burned. The card says:
>
> "This card is burned when you have either skipped 3 turns or paid 6 pool
> in cumulative penalties."
>
> Does this mean that
>
> A) The card is burned if 3 Metuselahs in a row skips or pays.
>
> B) Either 6 pool total is paid by some Metuselahs or all Metuselahs
> have skipped 3 turns, whichever comes first.
>
> If neither of my theories is correct, please give me the correct ruling.
> I would very much like to play with the card but as of yet I have not
> dared use it, since I am not fully aware of all the aspects of it.
>

The way I read it, and has been played in our group, is that "you" refers
to the player playing the card. Therefore, the card is burned when the
player of the card has skipped 3 turns OR paid 6 pool. Note the OR. This
does not allow for a combination of skips and paid; it is burned when one
or the other condition is met.

>
> /Robert, fanatic Ventrue/Toreador Player
